changelog.notes: Startup fix — the app opens instantly again.
changes: Fixed: the app taking 15-20 seconds to open after an online song or radio station was played — the saved online song used to load over the network before the app could open; it now loads only when you press Play
The Online tab now starts loading only when you open it, instead of fetching in the background on every launch
Online hosts that are slow or down now give up in 8 seconds instead of leaving the tab hanging

changelog.notes: New Online tab — Audius, Radio and Jamendo.
changes: New: Online tab — a whole new section for online music, next to Home, Search and Library
Audius: trending songs and search — full songs from independent artists, free and legal, tap to play
Radio: top live radio stations from around the world, with search and a LIVE badge
Jamendo: free-licensed songs — it needs your own free Jamendo client ID; the tab explains how to get one in 2 minutes and paste it in
Online songs play in the same player — mini player, Now Playing, lyrics and equalizer all work as usual
Settings → Appearance → Default tab can now also open on Online

Fixed: songs disappearing from the library on their own — when the phone's media library answered late or partially (for example right after a restart), the automatic refresh replaced your whole library with that incomplete list
Automatic refreshes now only ADD new songs and can never remove any; a manual scan from the Scan button still rebuilds the library fully, including removing deleted songs
A degraded scan can no longer overwrite good song info (artist, album, cover) with bare file names

changelog.notes: Lyrics/covers fetch fixes, home-screen widget with live lyrics, theme ripple.
changes: Fixed: lyrics missing for many songs — the LRCLIB request was missing a required field, so exact matches never worked; search is smarter now too
Fixed: HD covers missing for many songs — cover matching is no longer over-strict, and the retry wait after a failed lookup is 1 day instead of 7
Fixed: bulk lyrics download now retries songs it missed instead of marking them done
New: home-screen player widget — cover on top, play/pause/next/back controls, and the live lyric line underneath
New: switching themes, accents or dark/light now plays a ripple animation in the new colour

changelog.notes: Volume-spike fix + 24 progress-bar designs for the player.
changes: Fixed: volume jumping up then coming back down when the first song plays — the equalizer now loads your saved sound first and switches on last, in one clean step
New: 24 progress-bar designs — Kitty Cat, Spider Web, Arc Core, Smash Green, Neon Glow, Rainbow, Waveform, Heartbeat, Piano Keys, Vinyl, Galaxy, Gold, Lava, Sakura and more
Pick yours in Settings -> Player & Lyrics -> Progress bar style, or long-press the progress bar in the player
All designs are drawn in code (no images) — the app stays the same light size

changelog.notes: Support page updated: DPay removed — now you can support Dhunn directly via JazzCash, NayaPay or Easypaisa (one number, copy buttons) or Binance Pay. Changelog display hardened so no version can appear blank again.
changes: Support Dhunn page: DPay removed
JazzCash, NayaPay and Easypaisa added — send to 03287331958, with copy buttons for the number and account title
Binance Pay stays (Pay ID 774780411)
Changelog display hardened — no version can appear blank again

changelog.notes: Removed: the UI themes experiment — the app is back to its clean original look with the colour presets. Album art: all 52 designs are now animated (spinning discs/reels, pulsing glows, swaying frames, dancing EQ and wave bars) using light transform animations that do not cause lag, and they pause when the music pauses. Lyrics effects: previews in the grid are now LIVE animations — each card plays the effect on sample lines so you can see it before selecting.

changelog.notes: Fixed: 'Playback failed: Connection aborted' when tapping a song again and again or switching songs very fast. Song loads no longer collide with each other; only the latest tap is played and interrupted loads stay silent instead of showing an error.

changelog.notes: Ads added (Monetag, interstitial only): a full-screen ad may appear shortly after opening the app and then only every 6th song, at least 3 minutes apart, max 4 per session. Playback is never interrupted mid-song. Don't want ads? Settings → Equalizer & Playback → Ads → Off.

faqs.a: Yes — Dhunn is completely free. No ads, no subscriptions, no locked features.
No. Your songs play fully offline from your phone. Internet is only used for lyrics, HD cover images and checking for updates.
faqs.q: Does Dhunn need an internet connection?

faqs.a: Only for the Fluid Beat background: the app listens to the music's beat (not your voice) to animate the background. Nothing is ever recorded or sent anywhere.
faqs.q: Why does Dhunn ask for microphone permission?

faqs.a: When a new version is released, Dhunn shows an update message automatically. You can also check any time in Settings → Updates & FAQs → Check for updates.
Make sure you allowed the Music & audio permission, then go to Settings → My Library and scan your device again.
faqs.q: My songs are not showing up. What do I do?

faqs.a: Yes. Open the song, tap the edit (pencil) icon near the lyrics, and pick a lyrics file or write/paste your own. Your lyrics are saved and used offline.
faqs.q: Lyrics are missing for a song. Can I add my own?

faqs.a: No. There is no account, no sign-up and no tracking. Your music and your data never leave your phone.
faqs.q: Does Dhunn collect my personal data?

faqs.a: While a song is playing, tap the style icon at the top of the player — or go to Settings → Player & Lyrics → Album art style. There are 11 styles with a live preview.
